title: Playtest checklist
summary: M1 brings Millbrook into Unity from the frozen canon, and the Engine Bench, where engine-sim runs in the game for the first time.
tryThis: Double-click Play.bat. Millbrook opens: fly with W A S D and the mouse.
Keys 1 to 0, minus and equals jump to the 12 views of the contact sheet. Open the browser game beside it and compare.
Press Esc for the menu and choose Engine Bench. Tap I for ignition, hold I to crank the flat-four, rev it with W, press Dyno sweep.
Esc, then Credits, lists every licence. F10 opens this checklist.

items.text: Is it the same town as the browser game?
Which view looks most different? (say which in the comment)
Does the engine sound like a real engine?
Any crackles or dropouts in the engine sound?

knownIssues: There is nothing to drive yet: driving arrives in M2.
The Esc menu is a stand-in; the full menu with settings and controls comes in M2.
